newsitem.title: USA: Earthgrains Q2 helped by restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Earthgrains Q2 helped by restructuring.

text.p: Earthgrains Co said Monday its record second quarter operating earnings reflect the benefits from restructuring and consolidation efforts, as well as profit margin improvements.

Also contributing to second quarter results were typically strong seasonal sales for U.S. bakery products, price increases to offset higher flour costs, and efforts to reduce costs and improve operating efficiency.
Earlier, Earthgrains reported operating earnings excluding charges for the second quarter ended September 10 of $0.51 a share, compared with a pro forma loss a year ago of $0.32.
Including a $1.0 million restructuring charge, Earthgrains earned $0.45 a share. A year-ago, Earthgrains posted a net loss of $0.44 a share after a $1.9 million charge.

Earthgrains, which makes fresh baked goods and refrigerated dough, said sales for the second quarter were $381.8 million in the second quarter compared with $383.1 million a year ago. Eliminating facilities that were closed or sold due to restructuring, sales for the quarter increased 5.2 percent or by $18.9 million, it added.
